body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.40 (naive base rate 0.50) that: Hims & Hers Q4 2026 adjusted EBITDA is ≥$80M (midpoint of its $70–90M guide). Evidence: 8-K 9-Nov-2026 (Q3 2026): revenue +49% YoY (second straight quarter of acceleration). Guidance: Q4 revenue $875–895M, adjusted EBITDA $70–90M (8–10% margin); FY2026 revenue tightened to $3.13–3.15B and adjusted EBITDA reduced to $257–277M. CFO Yemi Okupe: 'deliberate strategic decisions to position… for durable, multi-year growth' (i.e., investment over margin). Reasoning: A company that just cut its EBITDA guide while framing it as 'deliberate investment' tends to keep spending; the 20M-wide range invites a sub-midpoint print. Lean below coin-flip. Resolution: YES if HIMS's reported Q4 2026 adjusted EBITDA (Q4 earnings release) ≥ $80.0M. Source: Hims & Hers Q4 2026 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 1773751). Resolve by 2027-03-10; score with Brier vs base rate.
